purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and prompt controls for a foreign counterseal claim heard on Cistern House Nine's public landing.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the pump-house landing, ordinary claim registration, answering-seal succession dispute, fresh field failure, interim relief, final remedy, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the establishing landing, registry routine, opening evidence affordances, ordinary fold, Brakka's entrance, succession dispute, succession choice, Tavi's entrance, fresh-failure reveal, interim relief, remedy threshold, and each ending family. Entrances and the canvas-wrapped meter-vane reveal receive distinct replay beats.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt stands alone for a general image model: it restates visible geometry, lighting, materials, characters, tools, and evidence. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints and are excluded from prompt assembly.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise dark ink linework with restrained watercolor, worn limestone, brass, iron, clay, wool, leather, warm amber rune lamps against cold blue-white mana glints, expressive humane faces, readable silhouettes, practical public machinery, unlettered image surfaces.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble every prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for named characters or groups visible in that frame, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Never include refs for absent characters or continuity-note prose.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture reuses Cistern House Nine from multiple angles and stages evidence transfers across fixed custody lines. A draft plan defines levels, zones, routes, sightlines, staging slots, and branch-persistent object locations.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, make a plan view or simple 3D blockout of Cistern House Nine with the upper public landing, lower dry gallery, wet intake opening, three pumps, grated stair, hoist, street passage, lower service door, claims table, bench, route map, public gauge, yellow line, and three custody trays.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view inside a two-level underground public pump house carved from pale worn limestone. On the upper street landing, a short sturdy adult halfling woman with brown skin, dark curls under a green kerchief, patched russet wool coat, leather satchel, field books, a green contract ribbon, and a stoppered jar of glassy white root stands beside a long stone claims table and a wall-mounted water gauge. A yellow painted line separates the public landing from a grated stair descending to a dry service gallery. Below, three squat brass-and-iron pump engines stand behind safety rails over a misty black-water intake; red isolation wedges, glass pressure floats, outlet valves, a chain hoist, and an arched blue-glowing mana conduit are visible. Dwarf householders wait along the street wall with copper cans beneath warm amber rune lamps.

visible_characters.default_stance: at the claims table with contract ribbon, field books, root jar, and satchel
orderly along the street wall with copper vessels

The street passage enters from the upper east wall; the lower service door enters behind the pumps. The two routes must never collapse into one doorway.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable named-character and group visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for characters visible in a scene.

characters.mira_fen: Mira Fen: adult halfling woman, about half an adult human's height with sturdy compact proportions, warm brown skin, round alert face, dark tightly curled hair braided beneath a faded green kerchief, ink-stained fingers, patched russet wool coat over cream shirt, dark practical trousers, mud-brown ankle boots, weathered leather satchel. She carries field books, green contract ribbon, stoppered sample jars, and oatcakes. Her posture is patient until a material quantity is evaded.
characters.dorrin_veld: Dorrin Veld: adult dwarf man, short and broad with copper-brown skin, square spectacles, thick gray beard divided by two brass rings, blue archive apron over charcoal clothes, many small pockets holding chalk, clay, seal cord, and tongs. He keeps his hands deliberate and calls every custody transfer with clerkly gravity.
characters.brakka_sorn: Brakka Sorn: adult dwarf woman, short square powerful build, warm brown skin, severe oval face, black hair pulled back with one clean silver streak, dark green heavy work coat with brass fasteners, black work boots, heavy mountain-and-wave civic seal at belt. She carries an iron contract chest and stands as if every promise has mass.
characters.iven_chalk: Master Iven Chalk: elderly dwarf man, lean compact build, pale umber skin, long white beard cut square at the end, iron spectacles, ochre wool hearing robe over plain work clothes, narrow hands stained with gray seal clay. His posture is forward and impatient with evasive lineage.
characters.tavi_mere: Tavi Mere: young adult halfling man, about half an adult human's height with wiry compact build, freckled tan face, wind-tangled auburn curls, mustard wool scarf, patched brown vest over rolled-sleeve cream shirt, mud-dark wading trousers, soaked leather boots. He carries a canvas-wrapped copper meter vane level in both hands and moves with exhausted urgency.

groups.counterseal_claim_moot: Counterseal claim moot: three adult dwarf craft Masters of varied genders and ages, short sturdy bodies, plain ochre, gray, and dark red wool work robes over practical clothes, each carrying a distinct civic seal marked for masonry, public kitchens, or archive craft. They sit close together on a low stone bench beneath a carved mountain-route map and watch objects before speakers.
groups.cistern_house_nine_landing_queue: Cistern House Nine landing queue: adult and elderly dwarves in patched terrace work clothes, leather aprons, bakery whites, laundry wraps, and lift-maintenance coats, orderly behind a yellow floor line with copper cans, buckets, and one low wheeled trough. Their posture changes from morning patience to close public attention.
